disposition_reason: The original contextual model-to-neuron prediction task has an ordered score and a published Figure 3b mean of 0.05, supporting a design rather than an admitted win condition. Exact figure reduction, unrounded baseline and complete source cohort/panel mapping remain open. Neither native artifact MAE nor a new purged-sentence interface can establish improvement; selecting only a narrower population panel would not fulfill the complete intended task.

source_paper.title: Mapping the neuronal building blocks of human language with language models

evidence.locator: Results: Combinatorial linguistic encoding, Figure 3b; Methods: Language model predictivity and Neural predictivity dynamics and mapping
evidence.supports: Reports contextual Vicuna population predictivity 0.05 ± 0.01 mean ± SEM; describes ridge alpha 0.01, sentence-held-out correlation, 30 PCs and time processing.

evidence.locator: Author Readme.txt sections I, III and IV; https://zenodo.org/api/records/20128462/files/Readme.txt/content
evidence.supports: Eight participants/14 sessions; 100-ms firing-rate matrices and word-aligned responses; 30-PC embeddings; word timings and qid are available, private utterance strings are withheld.

evidence.locator: Author Readme.txt section II/IV: analysis/computation/code C1–D1 and analysis/computation/figure
evidence.supports: Author analysis scripts produce result_llm and figure notebooks consume those results; no code execution or analysis-archive body read was performed in this review.

evidence.locator: Complete scope and units; Native reconstruction; Prospective purged sentence prediction
evidence.supports: Existing implementation separates source reconstruction from a new five-fold purged sentence task, reports 567 header-counted columns, and prospectively averages people before sessions.
Native score is MAE to reference unit/layer/lag arrays; prospective score compares against operator-built baselines on a different split. Neither is original Figure 3b victory.

target.description: Preserve the complete original model-to-neuron predictivity panel across all source participants, sessions and eligible neurons. Figure 3b population correlation supplies a reported numeric anchor; its relationship to the individual-neuron temporal/layer panel and controls must be fixed without silently dropping those intended outputs.

dataset.description: Zenodo record 20128462: processed neural responses, source PCA embeddings, sentence qid and word timing metadata. Private spoken strings are absent; this is a supplied-embedding task.

cohort.description: Source paper reports 579 neurons from eight participants in 14 sessions. Author README confirms eight/14, while retained local header inventory reports 567 session-specific neuron columns. Reconcile inclusion and source output mapping; no convenient subset or changed session weighting may substitute.

split.description: Source within-session leave-one-sentence-out prediction repeats across sentence IDs. A new chronological five-fold/purged split or held-session/held-person experiment is an extension, not comparison to the published 0.05. The leave-one-sentence-out policy is verified; exact per-session sentence membership and its Figure 3b output join remain unbound.

inputs.description: Use released model embeddings and lexical controls plus sentence/time alignment to fit the source neural response mapping. The supplied 30-PC features are fixed published inputs; new transcript-dependent embeddings cannot be extracted from the withheld utterances.

preprocessing.description: Methods use 100-ms bins, 30 PCA components per layer and three-bin population-response smoothing. Original PCA exposure, speaker/lag masking, sentence mapping and exact pre-utterance support need an authenticated code-to-Figure-3b join before admission.

metric.description: Population predictivity is Pearson correlation between observed session population firing rate and model predictions under source sentence-held-out ridge regression. The paper reports mean 0.05 ± 0.01 SEM; artifact MAE and neuronal selectivity p-values are separate quantities.

aggregation.description: Figure 3b summarizes 14 session population predictivities. Exact layer selection, pre-utterance time reduction and session weighting must be recovered from its plotting/computation code; Figure 3e neuron-count weighting, -1000-ms controls and the local equal-person/unit average are not assumed interchangeable.

comparison.primary_metric: Original model-to-neuron predictivity panel; exact primary reduction unresolved, with Figure 3b population Pearson r as a source anchor

published_baseline.description: Figure 3b reports contextual Vicuna population mean predictivity 0.05 ± 0.01 SEM. This is verified paper context, not an admitted task baseline: the exact layer/time/session reduction, unrounded score, complete cohort and mapping to the intended full neural panel remain unresolved.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author C1–D1 computations and figure notebooks are the declared recovery route. No source-author baseline was run or scored, and existing private/local baselines on the purged split are not substitutes.

minimum_effect.rationale: Set a scientifically meaningful correlation gain only after unrounded source scores, published rounding, source control variability and participant dependence are resolved; 0.01 SEM is not automatically an effect threshold.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired participant-level uncertainty while retaining the source 14-session performance summary; audit repeated-session dependence and selection across layers/lags.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Eight participants, with 14 sessions nested within participant.
uncertainty.rationale: The source SEM and significance comparisons do not themselves define an improvement test, and hundreds of neurons are not independent participants.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate the exact original Figure 3b endpoint, full cohort and unrounded contextual author baseline before enabling paper-win admission.
Preserve all intended source sessions, neurons, temporal/layer outputs and controls; do not promote a convenient population-only subset to a win for the complete model-to-neuron task.
Retain the original sentence-held-out split, source embeddings, input exposure, response processing and layer/time/session reduction for candidate and comparator.
Require a justified positive improvement beyond baseline rounding and a predeclared participant-aware uncertainty rule; preserve lexical/shuffle diagnostics.
Native array reproduction, greater linguistic selectivity, a new model on the purged split or a newly equal-person-weighted score cannot count as surpassing the published 0.05.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was reviewed or claimed; source-paper and author-rerun comparisons are separate.

episode.improvement_loop: Design only. After baseline/code mapping and access budgets are qualified, expose declared training/validation feedback for iteration on the original embedding-to-neural prediction problem.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate code, allowed embedding families, original sentence IDs, preprocessing, layer/lag selection policy, Figure 3b reduction, resource caps and uncertainty before final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Use an independent scoring implementation on the exact original support and published aggregation, preserving participant/session pairs and both rounded published and unrounded rerun scores. New purged folds remain an extension.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep the reported 0.05, the future authenticated original-author rerun, native artifact MAE and prospective operator baseline scores in separate fields; only a matched original comparison can support paper victory.

blocking_issues: Exact Figure 3b layer/time selection, session weighting and unrounded numerical baseline are not bound to author figure code.
Paper 579-neuron versus local 567-column discrepancy requires reconciliation across all eight participants/14 sessions.
Original PCA/masking/smoothing exposure and source-to-adapter numerical parity are unqualified.
Existing native MAE and purged-fold scorer are not a working evaluator of same-task improvement.
Meaningful effect, valid participant-level uncertainty, protected access policy and concrete resource/access budgets remain unset.

legacy.notes: Preserve all original native reconstruction and purged-sentence prediction materials. Matching source arrays is calibration; the chronological/purged evaluation is an explicitly separate extension and cannot be relabeled as a win over the source Figure 3b result.
